flags.risk: Physical and economic displacement, land take and loss of livelihoods in Mbandjock town and nearby villages
flags.why: A populated town and villages lie inside the 5 km footprint. A reservoir, dam or associated infrastructure could require physical relocation and land acquisition, and a hydro scheme of this kind would normally bring PS5 into scope.

flags.risk: Community health, safety and services disruption (construction traffic, dam safety, access to schools and hospital)

evidence.name: Lycée technique / classique de Mbandjock; Ecole Publique de Mbandjock

flags.why: Schools and a district hospital sit on site, and a trunk road runs through it. Construction traffic, blasting, dust, and dam-safety risks for downstream populations all need assessment.

flags.risk: Existing hazardous infrastructure (oil pipeline) within the footprint
flags.why: A major oil pipeline crosses the footprint. Crossings, access and proximity safety, and the risk of damage during construction, need to be checked against the project layout.

flags.risk: River and aquatic habitat modification, changes to flows and fish passage, and downstream water users

evidence.name: Banga, Bémon, Mokona and other watercourses on site

flags.why: Several rivers lie on site. Hydro works change flow regimes, sediment, water quality, aquatic habitat and fish migration, with effects extending downstream to households and livelihoods that depend on the rivers.

flags.risk: Possible impacts on forest habitat and threatened species (Grey Parrot EN; Microberlinia bisulcata EN)
flags.why: The threatened-species records are old (1948 and 1988) and sparse, so current presence is uncertain. Mapped forest on site and the nearby records still justify a field survey, and clearing or inundation could affect habitat if confirmed.

flags.risk: Impacts on places of worship and possible chance finds of cultural heritage

evidence.name: Sanctuaire Marial de la paroisse Notre Dame des champs

flags.why: Two religious sites are inside the footprint. Access, noise, and inundation or relocation could affect them. Chance-find procedures are also needed for excavation.

flags.risk: Indigenous peoples and forest-dependent communities not captured in the data

evidence.name: No mapped indigenous or community land within 20 km

flags.why: No mapped records exist, but OSM coverage is incomplete. Forest areas in the Centre Region can host Indigenous or forest-dependent groups, so PS7 cannot be ruled out until a field check is done.

category_drivers: Populated town (Mbandjock) and villages inside the footprint, with possible physical displacement under a reservoir or dam scheme
Hydro works on several rivers inside the footprint, with downstream effects on flows, fish and water users
Community facilities (hospital, schools) and an oil pipeline inside the footprint
Provisional: could drop to B if the scheme is a small run-of-river plant with no reservoir or resettlement
data_gaps: Project scale, type (dam, reservoir or run-of-river) and layout, including intake, powerhouse, transmission and access routes
Population and census data, and land tenure and use
Downstream water users, fisheries and livelihood dependence on the rivers
Current biodiversity survey data; GBIF records are old and sparse
Indigenous peoples and forest-dependent communities not mapped in OSM
Heritage survey beyond OSM; the OSM heritage layer is sparse
OSM coverage in Cameroon is incomplete, so absence of protected areas, wetlands or Ramsar sites is not confirmed

events.system:
You are a geospatial analyst doing a desk-based screen of a project site for environmental and social (non-technical) risk, in IFC Performance Standard terms. You can only see the site's location, country and asset type. Use the tools to look at open data around the site.

Finish with a summary for a person of no more than 400 words, then exactly one JSON block in a ```json fence:
{
  "flags": [{"risk": "", "ps": "PS5|PS6|PS7|PS8|PS4|context", "confidence": "high|medium|low",
             "evidence": [{"concept": "", "name": "", "distance_km": 0, "source": ""}], "why": ""}],
  "ps5": true, "ps6": true, "ps7": false, "ps8": false,
  "category": "A|B|C",
  "category_drivers": [""],
  "data_gaps": [""]
}
"flags" lists the risks you found, one per distinct risk. "ps5" to "ps8" mean: would IFC expect this Performance Standard to apply to the project?
Screen the place, not a particular project: don't try to work out which project this is or look up documents about it.

Use your own judgement about which data to check and how to interpret it.
